                        QUERY PLAN                         
-----------------------------------------------------------
 Sort
   Sort Key: (sum(o.amount)) DESC
   ->  HashAggregate
         Group Key: c.country
         ->  Hash Join
               Hash Cond: (o.customer_id = c.id)
               ->  Seq Scan on orders o
                     Filter: (status <> 'cancelled'::text)
               ->  Hash
                     ->  Seq Scan on customers c
(10 rows)
